text: An old farmer's only horse ran away.
"What bad luck," said the neighbors. The farmer said, "Maybe."
Days later, the horse came home, leading a wild stallion.
"What good luck!" said the neighbors. "Maybe," said the farmer.
His son tried to ride the wild horse. He fell, and broke his leg.
Then soldiers came, taking every young man to war.
Every young man, except one with a broken leg.
Who knows what today will turn into.
